Mei Chen: Hey team — quick sync on Lumen Labs (Wave 0). They accepted the invite but mentioned SSO + data residency questions. Can we confirm enablement slots and make sure we capture initial feedback after the first session? :wave:
Raj Patel: I can check SSO status this afternoon. pinged infra for the SAML cert, ETA 3pm PT.
Emily Torres: I scheduled an enablement: Tue 03/26 11am PT (30m). Sent calendar to Lumen and added pre-read. Let me know if we need a longer runbook.
Carlos Gomez: Re: data residency, we have the Private deploy checklist but need to confirm which region they want pinned. Lumen said 'EU' in email.
Mei Chen: Perfect. Raj — can you confirm SAML works for EU region? If not, we should give them a fallback (hosted w/ EU routing) and a note about logs retention.
Raj Patel: On it. If infra can't provision SAML in EU, we can stand up a dedicated EU routing policy for them. Will update by EOD.
Carlos Gomez: For feedback capture, suggestion: run a 3-question micro-survey right after the enablement via a simple webhook. Example payload we used for another pilot:
```
POST https://hooks.internal/preview-feedback
{
  "customer": "lumen-labs",
  "session_id": "{{session}}",
  "q1": "Was the enablement useful? (y/n)",
  "q2": "Top blocker right now:",
  "q3": "Would you like a follow-up deep-dive? (y/n)"
}
```
Mei Chen: Love that. Can you set up the hook and add me as the recipient for responses? I want to collate into the pilot board.
Carlos Gomez: Yep — I'll deploy the hook and add a tiny form. Will post the capture URL here once live.
preview-bot: Reminder: Lumen Labs enablement session scheduled by Emily Torres on 2025-03-26T18:00:00Z. Use /feedback-create to attach prompt set.
Emily Torres: Also flagged a quick ask from Lumen: sample prompts they'd like run during the session. Mei — can you share the curated prompt pack for Wave 0?
Mei Chen: Shared a short prompt pack in the shared drive: https://redwood.app/drive/wave0/lumen-prompts — includes 8 prompts, expected token costs, and success criteria.
Raj Patel: Infra confirmed SAML cert is in place for EU tenant. No blockers on SSO.
Carlos Gomez: Hook is live: https://hooks.internal/preview-feedback/lumen-175 — will post results to the pilot board and DM the raw responses.
Mei Chen: Great work. Action items: 1) Emily — run the 30m enablement and collect initial survey, 2) Carlos — monitor hook and escalate if malformed responses, 3) Raj — follow up if any SSO flakiness after session. I'll synthesize notes and add a renewal-risk flag if they report major blockers.
Emily Torres: Got it. I'll also capture a quick NPS-style thumbs up/down during call.
Mei Chen: Thanks all :thumbsup: — marking this thread done unless new blockers come up.
Carlos Gomez: closing loop — posted first survey template to the board, will iterate after session.
preview-bot: Thread archived to pilot-wave0 after 24h of inactivity.
